faq.question: What does Mesut mean?
faq.answer: Mesut is associated with the Arabic form مَسْعُود, whose core sense is mesut; fortunate, happy (turkish form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Mesut?
faq.answer: Mesut is associated with Arabic. Mesut is the Turkish form of Arabic مَسْعُود (Masʿūd), meaning 'fortunate, happy'.

faq.question: Is Mesut an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form مَسْعُود is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Mesut an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Mesut can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Mesut a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Mesut should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Masʿūd is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.answer: Romanization variants include Mesut, mesut. Script forms are مسعود, مَسْعُود, मसूद.
